name: spendgate
description: SpendGate - purchase requests, department budgets and approval workflows.

scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:server: node init && npm run dev -w server
scripts.dev:client: node init && npm run dev -w client
scripts.dev:mcp: node init && npm run dev:mcp -w server
scripts.build: node init && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.db:reset: prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:migrate -- --name init && npm run db:seed
scripts.start:prod: node init && prisma migrate deploy && node server/dist/database/seed.js && node server/dist/production.js
